faq.heading: Small questions before the first jar.
faq.intro: Straight answers about storage, crystallization, and what goes into every jar.

items.question: How should honey be stored?
items.answer: Store it closed at room temperature and away from direct sunlight. Refrigeration is not needed because cold speeds crystallization.

items.question: Does natural honey crystallize?
items.answer: Yes. Crystallization is natural and does not mean the honey is spoiled. You can gently warm the jar in water up to 40°C.

items.question: Do you add sugar or additives?
items.answer: No. We pack honey without unnecessary additives, aromas, colors, or preservatives. Its character depends on forage and season.

items.question: Which honey should I try first?
items.answer: Acacia is the mildest, meadow honey is floral and everyday, while linden honey is aromatic and pronounced.

familyTradition.heading: A story spanning generations
familyTradition.paragraph1: In the village of Mračaj near Prnjavor, surrounded by the forests and meadows of the area, our family has continued its beekeeping tradition for four decades.
familyTradition.paragraph2: Every drop of our honey carries a story of dedication, patience, and deep respect for nature. Our bees roam freely over meadows full of wildflowers, collecting nectar that transforms into the purest honey.

preparation.title: Hive Preparation
preparation.description: In spring, we prepare the hives for the new season, ensuring bee health and optimal conditions for honey production.

pollination.title: Pollination & Collection
pollination.description: Our bees freely fly across the meadows and forests around Mračaj, collecting nectar from acacia, linden, and diverse wildflowers.

harvest.title: Honey Harvest
harvest.description: We carefully extract honey at the right time, when the comb is sealed and the honey has reached perfect maturity.

filtering.title: Filtering
filtering.description: The honey is gently filtered to remove impurities while preserving all natural enzymes and nutrients.

bottling.title: Bottling & Packaging
